anchor.text: Sam's invoice goes out today. The one rule.
anchor.doneText: Invoice SENT. That was the whole game.

cards.title: Text Dana about Saturday
cards.first: "Hey, still on for Sat? 10 works for me." Send.

cards.title: Text Mom back
cards.first: "Sorry, crazy week. Call you Sunday?" Send.

cards.title: Reply to the landlord about the leak
cards.first: Open his email. "Thursday morning works, anytime after 9." Send.

cards.title: Book the dentist
cards.first: Call, or use the online form. First slot they have in October. Done.

cards.title: Send the September invoice to Sam
cards.first: Open last month's invoice. Duplicate it. Change the dates and line items. Send.

cards.title: Decide whether to go to the November conference
cards.first: Pick one: (a) go, (b) skip, (c) ask if they'll comp the ticket. Then send the email that matches. Deciding is the task.

cards.title: Fix the bio on the website
cards.first: Open the about page. Replace the first paragraph with what you'd say out loud. Ship it.

cards.title: Review Priya's proposal draft
cards.first: Open it. Comment on the intro only. Then the next section if the timer's still running.

cards.title: Do the expense report
cards.first: Open the form. Enter the three receipts you can see in your inbox. Submit what you have.

cards.title: Rework the pitch deck for Thursday
cards.first: Open the deck. Fix slide 2 only. Stop there if you need to.
